howToUpdate: When an organizer (or 2+ reputable local outlets) publishes a 2026 date, rewrite that event's cardHtml with the real date (mon = 3-letter month, day = number), swap the 'tba' pill for 2026 confirmed, insert it into the #happenings list in date order, add a schema.org Event to the JSON-LD, update the 'Last updated' line, set status to 'published' here.
